answer: Each new identity must lock a bond equal to 20 days of median epoch earnings in a public garden of staked funds; the bond vests only after eight consecutive epochs of accepted work. Attestations must arrive as a river from at least ten distinct established keys across that stretch, not as a same-day burst. If fraud is later proven, three independently drawn juries act as a prism and a majority slash burns the bond. An attacker therefore pays fresh capital and calendar time once per sockpuppet, and cannot reuse one proof to clear a farm.
